title: History Browser date picker substracts one day (Android 14)
body:
Hey everyone. Noticing that when browsing historical data using the History Browser from the preferences dropdown, the date selection menu will subtract one day from the highlighted day after pressing "OK".

Build: c31617fd2c-2023.12.15 (3.2.0.2)
Android Version 14 (UQ1A.240205.002, February 5th)

1. Open top-right dropdown
2. Select History browser
3. Select a date
4. Tap "OK"

What should happen: Date selected is presented
What actually happens: One day prior to the selected date is presented

Let me know if further information is needed.

Example:
![1](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/50091069/4252dc3a-7412-41f2-9037-3ac5f0c70b07)
![2](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/50091069/07ef69de-1518-4ebd-a2aa-07b742e9197f)
